#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>

using namespace std;

bool DEBUG = true;
string name = "I";

class FastScanner {
public:
    FILE* dis;
    char buffer[1 << 17];
    int pointer;

    FastScanner(const string& filename) {
        dis = fopen(filename.c_str(), "rb");
        pointer = 0;
    }

    FastScanner(istream& is) {
        // Not used in this translation, as we use standard input
        dis = nullptr;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int ret = 0;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        bool negative = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        while (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            ret = 10 * ret + (b - '0');
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return negative ? -ret : ret;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        long long ret = 0;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        bool negative = false;
        if (b == '-') {
            negative = true;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        while (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            ret = 10 * ret + (b - '0');
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return negative ? -ret : ret;
    }

    char nextByte() {
        if (dis == nullptr) {
            // Should not happen in this context
            return 0;
        }
        if (pointer == (int)fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), dis)) {
            pointer = 0;
        }
        return buffer[pointer++];
    }

    string nextString() {
        string ret;
        char b;
        do {
            b = nextByte();
        } while (b <= ' ');
        while (b > ' ') {
            ret += b;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return ret;
    }

    ~FastScanner() {
        if (dis != nullptr) fclose(dis);
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner* scan;
    ostream* out;

    if (DEBUG) {
        scan = new FastScanner(cin);
        out = &cout;
    } else {
        scan = new FastScanner(name + ".in");
        // For output, using standard output as per instructions
        out = &cout;
    }

    float N = stof(scan->nextString());
    float P = stof(scan->nextString());

    int i = 0;
    while (true) {
        double val = i * (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 6.0 + i * (i - 1) * (N - i) / 2.0 + i * (N - i) * (N - i - 1) / 4.0;
        val = val / (N * (N - 1) * (N - 2) / 6.0);
        if (val >= P || i > N) {
            (*out) << i << "\n";
            break;
        }
        i++;
    }

    if (!DEBUG) {
        // No file output, so nothing to close
    }

    delete scan;
    return 0;
}
